title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #9 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Purushartha is about doing our duty and living rightly? (1 mark)
   A. Dharma
   B. Moksha
   C. Artha
   D. Kama

2. What does Prarthana mean? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer
   B. Rebirth
   C. Wealth
   D. Duty

3. To what does the Bhagavad Gita compare the soul in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. A stone
   B. A tree
   C. A person who changes old clothes for new
   D. A river

4. What does Paramatma mean? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. A daily prayer
   C. A holy river
   D. The Supreme Soul

5. Which of the five principles is about being born again? (1 mark)
   A. Prarthana
   B. Purushartha
   C. Punarjanam
   D. Prani Daya

6. Which principle is about the Supreme Soul? (1 mark)
   A. Prani Daya
   B. Prarthana
   C. Punarjanam
   D. Paramatma

7. Which is a safety rule for festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Play with fire
   B. Run in the temple
   C. Eat from the ground
   D. Ask an adult to light lamps

8. Who became the first Prime Minister of Kenya at that time? (1 mark)
   A. Tom Mboya
   B. Daniel arap Moi
   C. Jomo Kenyatta
   D. Mwai Kibaki

9. What does Maha Shivratri teach? (1 mark)
   A. Winning arguments
   B. Playing games all night
   C. Getting rich
   D. Self-control, faith and staying alert to do good

10. Which practice is part of Paryushan? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting
   B. Hunting
   C. Fasting
   D. Cheating

11. What does fasting on Maha Shivratri show? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Self-control
   C. Anger
   D. Greed

12. In which year did Kenya gain internal self-government? (1 mark)
   A. 2010
   B. 1950
   C. 1980
   D. 1963

13. What does Madaraka Day teach? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Cruelty
   C. Greed
   D. Patriotism and unity

14. Which day is linked with Venus? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. Friday
   C. Monday
   D. Sunday

15. What is the Indian name for Saturday? (1 mark)
   A. Shanivaar
   B. Guruvaar
   C. Ravivaar
   D. Mangalvaar

16. Which day is linked with Jupiter? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Tuesday
   C. Friday
   D. Saturday

17. Which activity helps you learn the days and planets? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding the calendar
   B. Painting
   C. Making a decorated calendar
   D. Copying from a book

18. The Indian traditional calendar is based on what? (1 mark)
   A. The school year
   B. Only the rain
   C. Only the stars of the south
   D. The Moon and the Sun

19. Which is a mistake? (1 mark)
   A. Using a chart
   B. Learning the table
   C. Mixing up Guruvaar and Shukravaar
   D. Making a song

20. Which day is linked with Mercury? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Sunday
   C. Wednesday
   D. Tuesday

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Compare the three festivals: Maha Shivratri, Paryushan Parva and Madaraka Day. (5 marks)

22. Write the Indian names for Thursday and Friday. (2 marks)

23. Write a weekly plan using English and Indian day names with one activity for each of three days. (5 marks)

24. What is a rite or ritual? Give one example. (2 marks)

25. Write the seven days of the week in the Indian traditional calendar with their heavenly bodies. (4 marks)

26. Describe the story of King Shibi and the dove and give its lesson. (4 marks)

27. Match the days to the planets: Budhvaar, Guruvaar, Shukravaar. (3 marks)

28. Explain the importance of celebrating Madaraka Day. (3 marks)

29. Give the meaning of Maha Shivratri. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Dharma
   Dharma is right living.

2. A — Prayer
   Prarthana is prayer.

3. C — A person who changes old clothes for new
   The body is like worn clothes.

4. D — The Supreme Soul
   It is the highest soul, God.

5. C — Punarjanam
   Rebirth.

6. D — Paramatma
   Paramatma is God.

7. D — Ask an adult to light lamps
   Adults should handle flames.

8. C — Jomo Kenyatta
   Jomo Kenyatta was the first Prime Minister.

9. D — Self-control, faith and staying alert to do good
   These are its lessons.

10. C — Fasting
   Fasting, prayer and charity.

11. B — Self-control
   It teaches self-control.

12. D — 1963
   On 1 June 1963.

13. D — Patriotism and unity
   It teaches love for country.

14. B — Friday
   Shukravaar.

15. A — Shanivaar
   Shani is Saturn.

16. A — Thursday
   Guruvaar.

17. C — Making a decorated calendar
   Decorating helps memory.

18. D — The Moon and the Sun
   It is lunar and solar.

19. C — Mixing up Guruvaar and Shukravaar
   Guruvaar is Jupiter and Shukravaar is Venus.

20. C — Wednesday
   Budhvaar.

SECTION B
----
21. (5 marks)
   Answer: Maha Shivratri is Hindu, a night of prayer for Shiva. Paryushan is Jain, of fasting and forgiveness. Madaraka Day is national, about self-government and patriotism. All bring people together.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for correct faith or type, 2 marks for themes, 1 mark for a similarity.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Thursday: Guruvaar. Friday: Shukravaar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any correct plan, for example Somvaar: help at home; Guruvaar: thank a teacher; Shukravaar: share with a friend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the format and 1 mark each for three correct day names with activities.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: A special action done in a set way at a festival, such as lighting a lamp or raising a flag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for example.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ravivaar: Sun; Somvaar: Moon; Mangalvaar: Mars; Budhvaar: Mercury; Guruvaar: Jupiter; Shukravaar: Venus; Shanivaar: Saturn.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for every two correct pairs, up to 4.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: A frightened dove flew into the king's lap and a hawk demanded it. The king offered his own flesh to save the dove. The lesson is that a kind person protects the weak.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the dove, 1 mark for the hawk, 1 mark for the offer, 1 mark for the lesson.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mercury, Jupiter, Venus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: It reminds us of Kenya's step to self-government on 1 June 1963, teaches patriotism and unity, and lets us respect the flag and the anthem.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: The great night of Lord Shiva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for great night and 1 mark for Shiva.
